subject: Biology
title: Biomolecules (Biology)
summary: Living tissue ke chemical analysis se acid-soluble pool (micromolecules, molecular weight ~1000 Da se kam) aur acid-insoluble fraction (macromolecules — protein, nucleic acid, polysaccharides) milte hain; lipid bhi isme aate hain kyunki membranes vesicles mein toot jaati hain.
Proteins amino acids ke polymers (heteropolymers) hain; polysaccharides (carbohydrate) sugars ke polymers; nucleic acids nucleotides ke polymers.
Enzyme zyadatar proteins hain jo activation energy ghata kar reactions tez karte hain. Inki activity temperature, pH aur substrate concentration par depend karti hai, aur inhibit bhi ho sakti hai.
Enzymes chhe classes mein classify hote hain (jaise oxidoreductase, hydrolase, ligase), aur kai ko cofactors chahiye: prosthetic groups, coenzymes ya metal ions.

formulas.name: Most abundant
formulas.formula: most abundant chemical in living organisms: water (70–90%);  most abundant protein in the animal world: collagen;  in the whole biosphere: RuBisCO

formulas.name: Amino acid
formulas.formula: α-carbon bonded to H, –NH₂, –COOH and an R group;  20 types;  zwitterion form at isoelectric pH

formulas.name: Lipids
formulas.formula: fatty acid + glycerol → mono-, di-, triglycerides;  saturated (no C=C) or unsaturated (one or more C=C);  phospholipids (lecithin) in membranes
formulas.mistake: Palmitic acid mein 16 carbons (carboxyl carbon milakar); arachidonic acid mein 20 — galat count mat karna.

formulas.name: Nucleotide
formulas.formula: nitrogen base + pentose sugar (nucleoside) + phosphate;  adenine, guanine (purines);  cytosine, uracil, thymine (pyrimidines)

formulas.name: Protein structure levels
formulas.formula: primary (sequence; N-terminal to C-terminal);  secondary (α-helix — right-handed);  tertiary (3-D folding);  quaternary (subunits — haemoglobin: 2α + 2β)

formulas.name: Bonds in polymers
formulas.formula: peptide bond (amino acids);  glycosidic bond (monosaccharides);  phosphodiester bond (nucleotides);  ester bond (fatty acid + glycerol)

formulas.name: Polysaccharides
formulas.formula: starch (helical, holds I₂ → blue);  cellulose (no complex helix, doesn't hold I₂);  glycogen (animal storage);  inulin (fructose polymer);  chitin (complex polysaccharide in exoskeletons and fungal walls)

formulas.name: Enzyme classes
formulas.formula: 1 oxidoreductases/dehydrogenases;  2 transferases;  3 hydrolases;  4 lyases;  5 isomerases;  6 ligases

formulas.name: Michaelis constant and inhibition
formulas.formula: Km = substrate concentration at ½Vmax;  competitive inhibitor resembles substrate — malonate inhibits succinic dehydrogenase
formulas.mistake: Competitive inhibitor Km badhaata hai par Vmax same rehta hai — confuse mat karna.

formulas.name: Cofactors
formulas.formula: prosthetic group (tightly bound — haem in peroxidase, catalase);  coenzyme (loosely bound, often vitamin-derived — NAD, NADP from niacin);  metal ion (Zn²⁺ for carboxypeptidase)

formulas.name: Fastest enzyme
formulas.formula: carbonic anhydrase: CO₂ + H₂O ⇌ H₂CO₃, about 600,000 reactions per second (≈ 10⁷ times faster than uncatalysed)

formulas.name: Effect of temperature and pH
formulas.formula: activity rises to an optimum, then falls; low temperature inactivates reversibly, high temperature denatures
formulas.when: Enzymes ko affect karne wale factors.

examples.title: Acid-insoluble fraction mein lipids
examples.problem: Lipids ka molecular weight chhota hai, phir acid-insoluble pool mein kyun aate hain?
examples.solution: Tissue peesne par cell membranes toot kar acid mein insoluble vesicles ban jaati hain, isliye lipids macromolecules ke saath neeche aa jaate hain.

examples.title: Enzyme class
examples.problem: Ek enzyme substrate se bina hydrolysis groups hata kar double bond chhodta hai. Kaunsi class?

examples.title: Competitive inhibition
examples.problem: Malonate succinic dehydrogenase ko kyun inhibit karta hai?
examples.solution: Malonate succinate jaisa dikhta hai, active site se judkar use block kar deta hai — competitive inhibition.

examples.title: Starch vs cellulose
examples.problem: Starch iodine se neela kyun hota hai par cellulose nahi?
examples.solution: Starch helical secondary structures banata hai jo I₂ molecules pakad sakti hain; cellulose mein aisi complex helices nahi.

examples.title: Haemoglobin structure
examples.problem: Adult haemoglobin ki quaternary structure kya hai?
examples.solution: Chaar subunits — do α aur do β chains — har ek mein ek haem group.

examples.title: Holoenzyme
examples.problem: Cofactor hatane par enzyme ki activity khatam ho jaati hai. Isse kya pata chalta hai?
examples.solution: Akela protein part (apoenzyme) inactive hai; cofactor zaroori hai, dono milkar active holoenzyme banate hain.

topics.title: Primary and secondary metabolites
topics.explain: Primary metabolites (amino acids, sugars) ka normal physiology mein pata role hai. Plants, fungi aur microbes ke secondary metabolites: pigments (carotenoids, anthocyanins), alkaloids (morphine, codeine), terpenoids (monoterpenes, diterpenes), essential oils (lemongrass oil), toxins (abrin, ricin), lectins (concanavalin A), drugs (vinblastine, curcumin), polymeric substances (rubber, gums, cellulose).

topics.title: Metabolic basis for living
topics.explain: Metabolites metabolic pathways se ek doosre mein badalte hain — anabolic (biosynthetic, energy lete) aur catabolic (degradation, energy chhodte). ATP energy currency hai. Living state ek non-equilibrium steady state hai jo kaam kar sakta hai.

topics.title: Nature of enzyme action
topics.explain: Substrate active site se judkar enzyme–substrate complex (ES) banata hai, transition state banti hai, products nikalte hain aur enzyme phir kaam ke liye free. Enzymes activation energy ghataate hain; ribozymes nucleic acids hain jo enzyme ki tarah kaam karte hain.

topics.title: Proteins and their roles
topics.explain: Collagen (intercellular ground substance), trypsin (enzyme), insulin (hormone), antibodies (infection se ladte), receptors (sensory reception, jaise smell), GLUT-4 (glucose ko cells mein le jaata).

topics.title: Effect of substrate concentration
topics.explain: Substrate concentration badhne par velocity badhti hai aur phir maximum (Vmax) par ruk jaati hai jab saari active sites bhar jaati hain.

topics.title: Nucleic acid structure basics
topics.explain: Nucleic acids mein phosphate ek sugar ke 3′ carbon ko agle ke 5′ carbon se jodta hai. B-DNA (Watson–Crick model) mein har turn mein 10 base pairs, 3.4 nm pitch aur base pairs ke beech 0.34 nm.

ratta: Collagen — most abundant animal protein;  RuBisCO — biosphere.
Six classes: Oxido, Trans, Hydro, Lyase, Iso, Ligase.
Haem — prosthetic;  NAD (niacin) — coenzyme;  Zn²⁺ — carboxypeptidase.
